local characterData = {mw.loadData('Module:UnitData/Data')}
local aoeData = mw.loadData('Module:UnitData/Data/AoE_Type')

function p.getDamage(frame)
    local characterName = frame.args[1] or ''
    local attackPattern = frame.args[2] or 'one' -- Default to first attack if not specified
    local manualPlacementCost = frame.args[3] -- Optional manual placement cost
    local manualTotalCost = frame.args[4] -- Optional manual total cost
    
    -- Find the character data using the name
    local unitId = nil
    for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do
        if displayName == characterName then
            unitId = info.name
            break
        end
    end
    
    if not unitId then
        return "Character not found"
    end
    
    -- Get character data using the ID
    local data = characterData[unitId]
    
    if not data then
        return "No damage data available"
    end
    
    local output = {}
    local finalDamage
    local placementCost = data.cost or 0
    local totalUpgradeCost = 0
    
    -- Calculate total upgrade cost and get final damage
    if data.upgrade then
        -- Find the highest upgrade level
        local maxLevel = 0
        for level, _ in pairs(data.upgrade) do
            if type(level) == "number" and level > maxLevel then
                maxLevel = level
            end
        end
        
        -- Calculate total upgrade cost
        for i = 1, maxLevel do
            if data.upgrade[i] and data.upgrade[i].cost then
                totalUpgradeCost = totalUpgradeCost + data.upgrade[i].cost
            end
        end
        
        if maxLevel > 0 then
            finalDamage = data.upgrade[maxLevel].damage
        else
            finalDamage = data.damage
        end
    else
        finalDamage = data.damage
    end

    -- Add cost information based on manual inputs
    if manualPlacementCost ~= "n/a" then
        if manualPlacementCost then
            -- Use manual placement cost
            table.insert(output, string.format("Placement Cost: %d", tonumber(manualPlacementCost)))
        else
            -- Use module placement cost
            table.insert(output, string.format("Placement Cost: %d", placementCost))
        end
    end
    
    if manualTotalCost ~= "n/a" then
        if manualTotalCost then
            -- Use manual total cost
            table.insert(output, string.format("Total Cost: %d", tonumber(manualTotalCost)))
        elseif not manualPlacementCost and totalUpgradeCost > 0 then
            -- Use module costs
            table.insert(output, string.format("Total Upgrade Cost: %d", totalUpgradeCost))
            table.insert(output, string.format("Total Cost: %d", placementCost + totalUpgradeCost))
        end
    end
    
    -- Rest of the damage calculation code remains the same
    local attackName
    if data.upgrade and data.upgrade[#data.upgrade] and data.upgrade[#data.upgrade].primary_attack then
        attackName = data.upgrade[#data.upgrade].primary_attack
    elseif data.primary_attack_no_upgrades then
        attackName = data.primary_attack_no_upgrades
    end
    
    -- Calculate DoT damage if available
    if attackName then
        local attackData = aoeData[attackName]
        if attackData and attackData.Effect then
            local effect = attackData.Effect
            if effect.Name == "Bleed" or effect.Name == "Burn" or 
               effect.Name == "Poison" or effect.Name == "Decay" then
                local tickDamage = finalDamage * effect.Multiplier
                -- Add effect information
                table.insert(output, string.format("%sEffect: %s", #output > 0 and "\n" or "", effect.Name))
                table.insert(output, string.format("Ticks: %d", effect.Ticks))
                table.insert(output, string.format("Multiplier: %.3f", effect.Multiplier))
                
                -- Calculate damages
                local damagePerTick = tickDamage
                local totalDotDamage = tickDamage * effect.Ticks
                
                -- Add damage information
                table.insert(output, string.format("Base Damage: %.2f", finalDamage))
                table.insert(output, string.format("Damage per Tick: %.2f", damagePerTick))
                table.insert(output, string.format("Total DoT Damage: %.2f", totalDotDamage))
                table.insert(output, string.format("Total Damage: %.2f", finalDamage + totalDotDamage))
            else
                table.insert(output, string.format("%sDamage: %.2f", #output > 0 and "\n" or "", finalDamage))
            end
        else
            table.insert(output, string.format("%sDamage: %.2f", #output > 0 and "\n" or "", finalDamage))
        end
    else
        table.insert(output, string.format("%sDamage: %.2f", #output > 0 and "\n" or "", finalDamage))
    end
    
    return table.concat(output, "\n")
end

function p.TotalDMG(frame)
    local characterName = frame.args[1] or ''
    local attackPattern = frame.args[2] or 'one'
    
    -- Find the character data using the name
    local unitId = nil
    for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do
        if displayName == characterName then
            unitId = info.name
            break
        end
    end
    
    if not unitId then return "0" end
    
    -- Get character data using the ID
    local data = characterData[unitId]
    if not data then return "0" end
    
    local finalDamage
    local attackCooldown
    
    -- Get final damage and cooldown from upgrades if available
    if data.upgrade then
        local maxLevel = 0
        for level, _ in pairs(data.upgrade) do
            if type(level) == "number" and level > maxLevel then
                maxLevel = level
            end
        end
        if maxLevel > 0 then
            finalDamage = data.upgrade[maxLevel].damage
            attackCooldown = data.upgrade[maxLevel].attack_cooldown or data.attack_cooldown
        else
            finalDamage = data.damage
            attackCooldown = data.attack_cooldown
        end
    else
        finalDamage = data.damage
        attackCooldown = data.attack_cooldown
    end

    -- Get the attack name from unit data
    local attackName
    if data.upgrade and data.upgrade[#data.upgrade] and data.upgrade[#data.upgrade].primary_attack then
        attackName = data.upgrade[#data.upgrade].primary_attack
    elseif data.primary_attack_no_upgrades then
        attackName = data.primary_attack_no_upgrades
    end
    
    -- Calculate DoT damage if available
    local totalDamage = finalDamage
    if attackName then
        local attackData = aoeData[attackName]
        if attackData and attackData.Effect then
            local effect = attackData.Effect
            if effect.Name == "Bleed" or effect.Name == "Burn" or 
               effect.Name == "Poison" or effect.Name == "Decay" then
                local tickDamage = finalDamage * effect.Multiplier
                local totalDotDamage = tickDamage * effect.Ticks
                totalDamage = finalDamage + totalDotDamage
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Calculate DPS (Damage Per Second)
    if attackCooldown and attackCooldown > 0 then
        local dps = totalDamage / attackCooldown
        -- Multiply by the specific number
        local multipliedDPS = dps * 9.20406514
        return string.format("%.0f", multipliedDPS)
    else
        -- If no cooldown found, just return the multiplied damage
        local multipliedDamage = totalDamage * 9.20406514
        return string.format("%.0f", multipliedDamage)
    end
end

-- Add this helper function for K formatting
local function formatNumberK(number)
    if number >= 1000 then
        return string.format("%.2fK", number/1000)
    else
        return string.format("%.0f", number)
    end
end

function p.getCost(frame)
    local characterName = frame.args[1] or ''
    local costType = frame.args[2] or 'placement' -- 'placement' or 'total'
    
    -- Find the character data using the name
    local unitId = nil
    for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do
        if displayName == characterName then
            unitId = info.name
            break
        end
    end
    
    if not unitId then return "0" end
    
    -- Special case for femto
    if unitId == "femto" then
        if costType == 'placement' then
            return formatNumberK(100000)  -- Force placement cost to 100000
        else
            return "inf"  -- Hide total cost
        end
    end
    
    -- Get character data using the ID
    local data = characterData[unitId]
    if not data then return "0" end
    
    local placementCost = data.cost or 0
    local totalUpgradeCost = 0
    
    -- Calculate total upgrade cost if needed
    if costType == 'total' and data.upgrade then
        local maxLevel = 0
        for level, _ in pairs(data.upgrade) do
            if type(level) == "number" and level > maxLevel then
                maxLevel = level
            end
        end
        
        -- Calculate total upgrade cost
        for i = 1, maxLevel do
            if data.upgrade[i] and data.upgrade[i].cost then
                totalUpgradeCost = totalUpgradeCost + data.upgrade[i].cost
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Return the requested cost type with K formatting
    if costType == 'total' then
        return formatNumberK(placementCost + totalUpgradeCost)  -- Include both placement and upgrade costs
    else
        return formatNumberK(placementCost)
    end
end

function p.getSpawnCap(frame)
    local characterName = frame.args[1] or ''
    
    -- Find the character data using the name
    local unitId = nil
    for displayName, info in pairs(characterMap) do
        if displayName == characterName then
            unitId = info.name
            break
        end
    end
    
    if not unitId then return "0" end
    
    -- Get character data using the ID
    local data = characterData[unitId]
    if not data then return "0" end
    
    -- Get spawn cap value
    local spawnCap = data.spawn_cap
    if not spawnCap then return "1" end -- Default to 1 if not specified
    
    return string.format("%d", spawnCap)
end

return p
